stt: Ask HN: which are some good self-help books?
x:
Your Brain at Work http://www.amazon.co.uk/Your-Brain-Work-Strategies-Distracti...

It uses the short stories from the work days of a senior manager and software consultancy owner to explain how and why the brain reacts the way it does in challenging situations and gives advice on how best to mitigate its limitations.

stt: Ask HN: What is the most mind blowing book you've ever read?
x: "Your Brain at Work" by David Rock is full of insights about the human brain in daily situations. What makes it different from many other neuro-biology books is that it does not only present scientific knowledge but enables you to put that knowledge to use immediately. It really changed my way of thinking.
